A provider returning web.RequestFuncs is merged with the built-in request
funcs; the load registers the stubs, the adapter overlays per request, and
a handler struct can inject the composed web.RequestRenderer.
-- go.mod --

replace github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web => WEBDIR

package web

import "embed"

//fabrik:web:templates
//go:embed all:templates
var Templates embed.FS
-- shared/providers.go --
package shared

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

//fabrik:provider
func NewTemplateRequestFuncs() web.RequestFuncs {
	return web.RequestFuncs{
		"who": func(r *http.Request) any {
			return func() string { return r.URL.Query().Get("who") }
		},
	}
}
-- web/templates/_default/_layout.html --
<html><body>{{ block "content" . }}{{ end }}</body></html>
-- web/templates/_default/home.html --
{{ define "content" }}<p>{{ who }} at {{ request.Path }}</p>{{ end }}
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	fabrikweb "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

//fabrik:web GET /
func Home(req *fabrikweb.Request) (fabrikweb.Response, error) {
	return fabrikweb.Template("home", nil), nil
}

// Status renders through the template set directly, without the adapter.
type Status struct {
	Renderer fabrikweb.RequestRenderer
}

//fabrik:http GET /status
func (s *Status) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := s.Renderer.Render(w, r, "home", "", nil); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "render failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}
}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	web2 "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"

	"app/shared"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		r := router.New()
		sharedWebRequestFuncs := shared.NewTemplateRequestFuncs()
		requestFuncs := web2.MergeRequestFuncs(web2.DefaultRequestFuncs(), sharedWebRequestFuncs)
		webTemplates, err := web2.LoadTemplates(web.Templates, "templates", requestFuncs.Stubs())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		adapter := web2.NewAdapter(web2.WithRenderer(webTemplates), web2.WithRequestFuncs(requestFuncs))
		requestRenderer := web2.RequestRenderer{Templates: webTemplates, Funcs: requestFuncs}
		webStatus := &web.Status{
			Renderer: requestRenderer,
		}

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/", adapter.Wrap(web.Home))
		r.Method("GET", "/status", webStatus.Get)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
